statements.impact_statement: The advisory is informational: Astral ended maintenance of `astral-tokio-tar` on 2026-11-03 and no version is patched. Its one carrier is `testcontainers` 0.28.0, which `ferropix-testkit`, the test-support crate (`publish = false`), uses to start the containers the integration tests run against. Every workspace root above reaches it only through a dev-dependency on `ferropix-testkit` or on `testcontainers`, so the crate is in none of the products. Neither published crate resolves it at all: `cargo tree -p ihe-iti` and `cargo tree -p nl-generic-functions`, all features and all targets, find no `astral-tokio-tar` node, and `ferropix-server` and `ferropix-console` reach it over no normal or build edge either. No release of `testcontainers` leaves the crate (0.28.0 requires ^0.6.1 and the upstream main branch requires 0.7.0). Re-evaluate when a `testcontainers` release drops the dependency, or if `ferropix-testkit` ever becomes a normal dependency of a shipped crate.
